articles.title: RBC checks suggest OpenAI device coming as early as September
articles.mainIdea: RBC checks suggest OpenAI device coming as early as September
articles.summary: Investing.com: RBC checks suggest OpenAI device coming as early as September. Investing.com -- RBC Capital said new supply chain checks point to a potential OpenAI hardware debut as early as September, a move the firm believes could signal the company’s push toward creating “a 3rd mobile ecosystem.” Related tickers mentioned: AAPL.
